name: ChatGPT
description: Sign in with ChatGPT: use OpenAI models on your ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan, no API key needed.
author: Jaron Wilson

steps.title: Sign in with ChatGPT
steps.body: Press **Sign in with ChatGPT** on this tab and approve Odysseus in the ChatGPT tab that opens. Each Odysseus user signs in to their own ChatGPT account; nobody else can use it.

steps.title: When the sign-in tab does not load
steps.body: ChatGPT sends you back to `http://127.0.0.1:1455/auth/callback`, which only loads on the Odysseus server itself. That is expected: copy the whole address from that tab and paste it under **Finish sign-in**.

steps.title: Use the models
steps.body: Your plan's models show in the model picker under **ChatGPT**, for chats, the agent and Company. Usage counts against your ChatGPT plan's limits, not an API bill; System > Usage counts it as a subscription.

steps.title: Coming from the built-in sign-in
steps.body: Signed in before this was an add-on? Your ChatGPT endpoint and chats were kept. An admin moves the sign-ins over once with the command in this add-on's README (`python -m chatgpt_mod.migrate`), or you just sign in again here.
